pattern_id: Data race during startup when switching from block-sync to consensus mode
description: BUG PATTERN: Intermittent data race in consensus.State during startup when switching from block-sync to consensus mode. DESCRIPTION: A data race occurs between reconstructLastCommit() writing to consensus state (called via SwitchToConsensus from BlockchainReactor.poolRoutine) and updateRoundStateRoutine() reading from the same state (started in Reactor.OnStart). The race manifests when block-sync completes and the node switches to active consensus participation. ROOT CAUSE: The consensus Reactor starts updateRoundStateRoutine in OnStart before the node may have finished block-sync. When SwitchToConsensus is called, it modifies state that the already-running routine is reading. No synchronization protects this transition window. LESSON: Mode transitions in consensus systems are race-prone: 1) Identify all goroutines started during OnStart and what state they access; 2) Mode switches (block-sync → consensus, catching-up → active) must synchronize with background routines; 3) Don't start routines that read consensus state until the state is fully initialized; 4) Use race detector in CI for consensus code - these bugs are intermittent and hard to catch otherwise; 5) Consider state machine patterns where mode transitions are explicit synchronization points.
